question: The average age of 52 students of a class is 12 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 13 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If a new member joins and the average increases, the new value can be calculated directly:

Teacher's Age = Old Average + (Total Members × Increase in Average)

Teacher's Age = 12 + (53 × 1)

Teacher's Age = 12 + 53 = 65

**∴ The correct answer is 65 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 52

Average age of students = 12 years

New average age including the teacher = 13 years

Total members including the teacher = 52 + 1 = 53

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 Teacher's Age = Old Average + (Total Persons × Increase in Average)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of ages of 52 students = 52 × 12 = 624 years

⇒ Sum of ages of 53 members = 53 × 13 = 689 years

⇒ Teacher's age = Sum of ages of 53 members − Sum of ages of 52 students

⇒ Teacher's age = 689 − 624 = 65 years

**∴ The correct answer is 65 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Averages (Net Deviation)

If a new value is added and the average increases, the new value is greater than the old average by an amount equal to (Total observations × increase in average).

Averages (Removal)

If a value is removed and the average decreases, the removed value was strictly greater than the old average of the group.

Combined Average

Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂) where n is the number of items and A is the average of each respective group.
